name: This Is Brilliant But I Like This
aka: This Is Brilliant, But I Like This
look: Two stacked frames from Top Gear outside a grand white mansion. A gray-haired presenter stands between a white Volkswagen and a red Ford Fiesta, gesturing at the red car above the subtitle "This is brilliant." and at the white car above "But I like this." A co-host leans on the red car.
use: Admits one option is objectively better while confessing a soft spot for the other. The red car gets the impressive, sensible choice, and the white car gets the one the speaker actually likes, usually something cheaper, sillier or worse.
slots: the objectively better option (red car, top frame)
the option you secretly prefer (white car, bottom frame)
examples: The cartoon I've seen forty times
describe: two guys comparing a red car and a white car outside a mansion
car show host says this is brilliant but i like this
british tv presenter points at a red hatchback then a white one
man admits one car is better but likes the other one
top gear guys standing between two small cars
origin: Two frames from the BBC motoring show Top Gear.
